exhibits.title: Dame Viviane Argent
exhibits.subtitle: Portraitist of the Living Image
exhibits.text: You have climbed far, welcome to the Gallery, where the pictures move. Everything you learned of Diffusion below still holds here, unchanged: the same forward noising, the same reverse denoising, the same squared loss on the predicted noise, the same latent compression, the same guidance. A moving portrait is made by exactly that machinery. Only the canvas has gained a new dimension, TIME, and the denoiser has gained one new sense: it looks not only across a single frame but along the whole reel, so the frames agree with one another. That single addition, attention run along time, is the heart of this floor. Walk the Gallery in order: from why independent frames flicker, through the temporal weave that steadies them, to why a portrait drifts if you ask it to move too long, and down at last to the causal cauldron that compresses time itself. Two stairs brought you here, one from the Latent Vault of Diffusion, one from the Compass and Clock of Attention, for a moving picture is those two arts, married along time.

exhibits.title: The Gallery of Moving Portraits
exhibits.text: This floor teaches VIDEO DIFFUSION, how the image-diffusion you learned below scales to moving pictures. Its one governing idea: a video is a stack of frames that must be denoised JOINTLY, so they stay consistent over time; everything distinctive here follows from solving that. The whole diffusion framework is inherited untouched, forward, reverse, ε-prediction, latent diffusion, CFG, U-Net or DiT denoiser. What is new is the SHAPE of the data (a time axis T) and ONE new attention axis (temporal). From this atrium the Gallery builds it up: the flickering of independent frames, factorized spatial-and-temporal attention, why length is variable and why quality drifts past the trained horizon, how Wan stitches longer reels, and the causal 3D VAE that compresses space AND time. Two stairs descend to the arts this one marries: Diffusion (its framework) and Attention (temporal attention, RoPE, the causal mask).

exhibits.title: How to Walk This Gallery
exhibits.text: Move with W, A, S, D and look with the mouse; press E to study any exhibit, and follow the glowing footsteps through each chamber's exhibits in study order, then on to the next. Press M for this floor's map, G for the constellation across the whole palace, F for Floo travel. The two descending staircases return you to the Latent Vault (Diffusion) and the Compass and Clock (Attention), the very chambers whose lessons this floor extends. Deeper still, the Undercroft holds the sliding-kernel mathematics (convolution) that the causal 3D VAE is built from. Moving Portraits is a derived art, applied atop trained image models, so it stands at the top of the lineage.
